data.name: ObjetivoSospect
data.value: SOSpect aims to allow the community to alert and receive alerts of dangers at a user's location, in order to avoid risks to them and their loved ones. The location of users is not shared or tracked, ensuring their privacy. Users can place hazard alerts to help others avoid falling victim to risky situations.

data.name: UbicacionImportante
data.value: It is important to know the user's location so that you can alert them if someone places a danger alert near their location. However, the user's location is private and only the points on the map where alerts are placed are shared.

data.name: GenteUnida
data.value: With SOSpect, the community can come together to reduce crime and avoid falling victim to risky situations, alerting others to stay safe too.

data.name: ExplicaZonaVigilancia
data.value: All alarms that are placed at the point you are going to select will be notified no matter who places them. That way, you can be aware of the dangers that are running at that point. This is ideal for being aware of hazards in places such as your children's schools or universities or areas where your relatives or loved ones work.

data.name: LblParaIniciar
data.value: LET'S START IN SOSpect!! To update nearby alerts, tap the blue refresh button

data.name: LblAlarmaNoGrave
data.value: Use the yellow button to place low-hazard alerts and alert your community or protectors. You can choose the type of alert and mark it as a crime committed. This button launches the alert in your exact location, being useful when you need help. You can also select a point on the map to locate the alert without compromising your location.

data.name: LblDescripcionAlarmas
data.value: In the 'Describe' option in the bottom bar, you will find a list of alarms placed by you or others. If you created the alarm, you can add a description. If the alarm was created by someone else, you can rate its veracity and complement its description. Be careful! If you provide false information or incorrect ratings, your account may be suspended. Carefully review the terms and conditions to avoid this.

data.name: LblDescripcionMensajes
data.value: In the bell in the top right corner, you can read your messages, which include subscription notifications and recent alarms. This list is different from the descriptions option, where you can find recent alarms directly.

data.name: LblRecomendaciones
data.value: TOGETHER WE ARE INVINCIBLE! The basic functions of alerting and receiving alerts within a radius of 100 meters are free, and when you start we give you 2 subscriptions. Invite your community and family to use this free service to combat rising crime. You can save lives or be saved by receiving an alert in time. Alerts of lost people or pets have a range of 10 kilometers, and violent demonstrations have a range of 1 kilometer

data.name: LblDescripcionMapa
data.value: At any time, you can select the "MAP" option on the left of the bottom bar, which is the starting point of SOSpect. From there, you can view nearby alarms. Your location will appear in the center of the map, and the circle represents the radius that could affect you. By default, this radius is 100 meters, but you can modify it in the settings menu.

data.name: LblRecomendacionImportante
data.value: It is important that you open SOSpect periodically, before leaving home or when you arrive at a place, to update your location. This way, we can let you know if there is any risk in your area. Please note that when the app is closed, we are unable to obtain your location due to restrictions imposed by device operating systems. Check in terms and conditions related to your location.

data.name: LblReportesDescripcion
data.value: Reports give you the opportunity to understand how you have helped other users by avoiding adverse situations. In addition, they allow you to identify dangerous areas on the map of your city and observe the evolution of crime over time. Also, through pattern analysis, it is possible to generate early warnings before negative events occur. It is important to note that the basic report is free, while other reports may have a cost due to the computational consumption necessary for their generation.

data.name: LblDescripcionMapaDeCalor
data.value: In this report, you will have access to a heat map of your area, where you can select different months since SOSpect began its operation. This functionality will allow you to observe and understand the evolution of each area of the map that is of interest to you.

data.name: LblCostoReporte
data.value: Keep in mind that the use of this functionality carries a computational cost and requires powers although it will not be a high value. However, you can acquire it without any problem using the powers that we give you in your first use of the application.

data.name: LblDescripcionEvolucionAlarmas
data.value: In this report, you will be able to know the trends of each type of alarm over time in your area. You will be able to observe and analyze dangerousness trends, as well as identify possible decreases in crime.

data.name: LblDescripcionReportesPredictivos
data.value: As the SOSpect community generates enough data, probability-based event predictions and analytical tools can be made. These reports will allow you to know when waves of alerts or increases in criminal activity are approaching, giving you the opportunity to take the necessary precautions to avoid any risk to you, your family and your community.

data.name: LblDescripcionAnalisisTextos
data.value: Thanks to the fact that users describe the alarms and update their evolution through the internal chat of SOSpect, this report will allow to visualize the typologies that most affect the community. This provides an opportunity to take action to improve the perception of safety in your area.

data.name: LblHolaBienvenido
data.value:
Hello! Welcome to SOSpect.
SOSpect is a free tool designed to protect you and your loved ones by providing timely alerts about nearby risks! You may not get many alarms at first, as there aren't many people near you yet who have installed SOSpect. We ask that you give us a try and do not uninstall the application. SOSpect can save your life at some point, as well as that of someone in your family or community.
In the "Basic Report" section of the "Reports" menu found in the settings, you can see in the "Basic Metrics" section the number of nearby users within your coverage area, where you will receive alarms. Help us increase that number, it's free and will allow you to live more safely!
We invite you to carefully read this short introductory manual, which will give you an idea of how SOSpect works. Please note that it will only be displayed once after the app is installed.
Thank you for using SOSpect and for contributing to everyone's safety!
Tap the screen to continue...

data.value: Advantages of Being in the Trusted Network

data.name: LabelV1UsuariosConfiables
data.value: 1. Identification and Verification of Trusted Users:

data.name: LabelV1UsuariosConfiablesDesc
data.value: Mechanisms to identify and verify users who consistently provide accurate and useful information. This ensures that the data shared within the network is of high quality and reliable.

data.name: LabelV2AlertasPrioritariasDesc
data.value: Alerts generated by verified users within the trusted network have higher visibility and priority. This means that they will stand out on the platform, allowing for a faster and more effective response from the community and authorities.

data.name: LabelV3RecompensasConfiabilidadDesc
data.value: Incentivize trusted users with in-app rewards, such as additional 'powers' or premium features. This not only motivates users to maintain their trustworthiness status, but also enriches their experience on the platform.

data.name: LabelMasVentajasDesc
data.value: Alarms generated by trusted network users are displayed with a green frame in the alarm list and a sign indicating that the alert is from a verified user. In addition, the pin on the map is marked in green, signaling that it is a verified alarm. Comments from trusted network users are also highlighted with a green sign, indicating their trusted provenance.

data.name: LabelObjetivoVentajas
data.value: Members of the trusted network are expected to be people far removed from crime, so their alarms are considered reliable and should be taken more seriously. This contributes to a safer community and more effective response to alerts.

data.name: LabelInstruccionesDatosBasicos
data.value: Please enter your basic details in order to join the SOSpect Trusted Network. Do this only if you know a network member who can add you. Make sure you provide real and correct information, as you won't be able to modify it after being added to the trusted network.

data.name: LabelDesventajasSubTitle
data.value: Disadvantages of belonging to the Trust Network

data.name: LabelDV1InvestigacionDesc
data.value: In cases where the competent authorities require it, alarms can be investigated if it is suspected that they have been placed irresponsibly or lyingly, affecting other citizens.

data.name: LabelDV2RequisitosDesc
data.value: SOSpect will verify that the investigation request has adequate grounds before submitting information. In addition, the delivery of information will be denied in cases related to governments or authorities linked to dictatorships, illegal groups, mafias or similar, to protect the user who created the alarm.

data.name: LabelDV3ImplicacionAgregadorDesc
data.value: In an eventual investigation, the user who added the creator of the alarm in the trusted network could be required by the competent authorities to cooperate in the investigation, with the same caveats mentioned above.

data.name: LabelDV4BorradoInformacionDesc
data.value: When users decide to delete their information from SOSpect and uninstall the application, SOSpect will delete it after 90 calendar days, after verifying that no complaints have been made by the competent authorities in relation to the alarms placed by the user.

data.name: LabelDV5ResponsabilidadDesc
data.value: Being a part of the trusted network comes with an additional responsibility, as members are expected to only add trusted users. If someone who doesn't meet these standards is added, there could be negative consequences.

data.name: LabelNoHayUsuarioEnRed
data.value: No trusted users on the network

data.name: LabelQueEsRedConfianzaDesc
data.value: The 'Network of Trust' in SOSpect is a feature designed to allow users to create a circle of trusted people within the app. By adding people you know and trust, your alerts and notifications will be treated with higher priority and visibility. The main objective is to improve the effectiveness and reliability of the alarms issued through the application, ensuring that alerts from verified users receive the necessary attention.

data.name: Label1IdentificacionUsuariosDesc
data.value: You can add people you know and trust to your trusted network. This will ensure that your alerts are considered as verified within the app, marked in green, and with increased visibility.

data.name: Label2PrivacidadDesc
data.value: Despite the priority given to trusted network alerts, all alarms remain anonymous. Users' identities and personal information will not be exposed to other users, ensuring privacy while improving the effectiveness of alerts.

data.name: Label3ComposicionRedDesc
data.value: The network is expected to be made up of people far from criminal activities. The inclusion of users in this network should be handled carefully, ensuring that only trusted people are added.

data.name: Label4DatosInalterablesDesc
data.value: Once a user is added to the trusted network, they will not be able to change their basic data or be removed from the network. This rule is implemented to maintain the integrity and reliability of the network.

data.name: LabelRecomendacionesRed
data.value: Recommendations for Adding Users to the Trusted Network

data.name: Label1VerificaIdentidadDesc
data.value: Before you add someone to your trusted network, make sure you know and verify the user's identity. Since your alerts will receive special treatment, it is crucial that you have full confidence in the veracity of the information provided.

data.name: Label2RevisaInfoDesc
data.value: It is important to make sure that the user's basic data, such as name, mobile number, email, and national identification document, is correct and up-to-date.

data.name: Label3ResponsabilidadAgregadorDesc
data.value: When you add a user to the trusted network, you take responsibility for ensuring that the user's data is accurate. This is vital to maintain network integrity and ensure that verified alarms are of high quality and reliability.

data.name: Label1InvestigacionAlarmasDesc
data.value: If required by the competent authorities, an alarm placed by a trusted network user can be investigated. SOSpect will take steps to verify the legitimacy of the request before handing over any information and will deny such handover in cases involving governments or entities associated with dictatorships, illegal groups, mafias, or the like.

data.name: Label2ImplicacionesAgregadorDesc
data.value: In the event of an investigation, the user who added the creator of the alarm could be required to cooperate, always under the same legal protections.

data.name: Label3EliminacionDatosDesc
data.value: If a user decides to delete their information and uninstall the application, SOSpect will proceed with the deletion of the data after 90 days, provided that no complaints have arisen from the competent authorities related to the alarms issued by the user.

data.name: LabelBienvenidoRedConfianza
data.value:
Welcome to the Network of Trust. Here you can add people you know and trust, allowing their alarms to be considered verified, marked in green, and given greater importance. Remember that all alarms will remain anonymous and no one's data will be exposed.
Alarms from people who are not part of your trusted network will appear in gray. The network is expected to be composed of trustworthy people who are far removed from criminal activities.
The users you add must provide their basic data by entering the SOSpect menu and filling in the required information. As an aggregator, it is your responsibility to ensure the veracity of this data. Once added, a user will not be able to change their data or be removed from the network.
